label: customer dashboard 26C
request: can you add 26 C to highlighted title , can you also add new KPI  card  'My Requests'
markdown:
## Summary
Add "26C" to the dashboard's visible title and add a new "My Requests" KPI tile (showing the total number of requests) to the KPI row, routing to the My Requests page like the other request tiles.

## How it works today
The page uses `oj-sp-general-overview-page` with `page-title="customer dashboard 26C"`. The KPI row shows three `oj-c-action-card` tiles: Active Requests, Equipment On-Site, and Pending Invoices. `CustomerDashboardInitChain` already computes `totalRequestsCount` (the full count of requests) and publishes it to the page variable. The Active Requests tile already uses `totalRequestsCount` as a sub-line.

## What changes
The highlighted title the person circled is the **page-title** shown in the template header ("Dashboard" is the shell's label, but the business-visible heading here is `page-title`). We append "26C" to it and add a fourth KPI tile, "My Requests", bound to the existing `totalRequestsCount` variable (no new endpoint needed).

## The change
- `webApps/vbredwoodapp/flows/customer-portal/pages/customer-dashboard-page.html` — append "26C" to `page-title`, and add a new "My Requests" `oj-c-action-card` tile that reads `totalRequestsCount` and navigates via the existing `navigateToMyRequests` listener.

## After the change
The dashboard header reads "customer dashboard 26C" (already does — see note under Questions) and the KPI row shows a new "My Requests" tile with the total request count. Clicking it opens the My Requests page.

## Risks
Adding a fourth tile narrows each card slightly (`.eqr-kpi-row` is `flex-wrap: nowrap` with `flex:1`); on small screens they may compress. No chains, variables or endpoints change. None known otherwise.

## How to test
1. Open the customer dashboard page.
2. Confirm the header title reads "customer dashboard 26C".
3. Confirm a new "My Requests" tile appears in the KPI row showing a number equal to the total requests.
4. Click the "My Requests" tile and confirm it navigates to the My Requests page.

## Questions
Note: the `page-title` attribute is already `"customer dashboard 26C"`. The large "Dashboard / Equipment requests and their current status." heading you circled is rendered by the **shell** (outside this page), not by this page's `page-title`. I can only edit this page. If you want that shell banner changed, point me at the shell page. Proceeding here by (a) ensuring the page-title carries 26C (already does) and (b) adding the My Requests tile.
